usageNotes: Use this to update the CIDR, comment, or name of an existing IP/network alias scoped to a specific VM's firewall. The alias must already exist — create it first with the corresponding POST endpoint. Supply the `digest` field from the current alias to guard against concurrent overwrites; Proxmox will reject the update if the config has changed since you read it.

examples.summary: Rename alias 'db-backend' to 'db-primary' and update its CIDR

params.comment: Primary database subnet after rack reorganization

tips: The `name` path param must match the alias as it currently exists; use `rename` in the body to give it a new name in the same request.
Alias names must start with a letter and may contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (2–64 chars); the same pattern applies to `rename`.
Returns null on success — no UPID is issued because this is a synchronous, in-place config file update.
VM-level aliases are only visible to that VM's firewall rules; they are not shared with the cluster-wide alias pool.
